labels._title: Moving a module out of a monolith: from a hexagonal monolith to two services that talk through REST adapters
labels._desc: Four hexagonal-architecture panels. Top left: a monolith whose business logic holds modules X, Y and Z behind a REST API adapter and a database adapter on MySQL. Step 1 (top right): modules X, Y and Z are decoupled through connector ports. Step 2 (bottom): module Z moves into its own service; the original monolith keeps X and Y and the two sides exchange calls through REST client and REST API adapters, each service keeping its database adapter.
